dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 19, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: June 19**

The Chicago White Sox dominated the Toronto Blue Jays 3-0 behind a strong outing from Sean Burke, who pitched 6.2 innings with 5 strikeouts and 0 earned runs. Colson Montgomery led the White Sox offense with a home run and 1 RBI. In a different game, the Los Angeles Dodgers took down the New York Yankees 8-2 with Yoshinobu Yamamoto tossing 9 innings of 2-run ball with 7 strikeouts.

The New York Yankees bounced back to win 2-1 against the Dodgers, with Tommy Edman hitting a home run and 1 RBI. The Atlanta Braves outlasted the Texas Rangers 8-5, with Austin Riley going 3-for-4 with 2 home runs and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates defeated the Cleveland Guardians 7-1, with Paul Skenes pitching 7 innings with 8 strikeouts and 1 earned run.
